literal.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The wording asks for the inspiratory pressure condition, not the diaphragm movement already included in the existing order49 explanation. OpenStax defines lung/intra-alveolar pressure and shows that during inspiration it falls below atmospheric pressure, producing inward airflow (L39-L43, L49-L53, L67-L71). Expiration raises pressure above atmospheric (L68, L73); pressure equalizes when airflow ceases (L51-L52); intrapleural pressure remains lower than intra-alveolar pressure (L53-L54). These phase and compartment qualifiers make index 1 the unique key.
